newsitem.title: CANADA: Toronto stocks climb to new highs at open.
newsitem.headline: Toronto stocks climb to new highs at open.

text.p: CHANGE CHANGE
NIKKEI 20389.54 +103.31 LME CASH NICKEL US$6700 -20.0
CANDLR 1.3829 LME CASH ALUM US$1650.5 +32.5
CAN 30-YR 120.40 +0.26 BRENT CRUDE US$18.38 -0.06

* Toronto stocks edged higher in light trade at the open on Friday, hitting a new life-time high. * 11 of 14 sub-indexes rose, led by communications. * 9.6 million shares traded worth C$149.4 million.
Toronto stocks edged into uncharted territory at the open on Friday in light trade as Canadian bank stocks shrugged off early bond weakness.

"Durable goods came out in the States stronger than expected, put a little pressure on the bond market initially but it's now turned around, you've got the stock market down there doing a little bit better, and banks up in Canada are starting to act positively to that," one trader said.
The Toronto Stock Exchange key 300 Composite Index rose 8.09 points to 6793.24 in turnover of 9.6 million shares worth C$149.4 million.
Advancing stocks outpaced declines 273 to 201, while 247 issues were flat.
Eleven of Toronto's 14 sub-indexes rose in early trade, led by communications, banks, real estate and transportation.
Conglomerates, pipelines and utilities shed value.
--- HOT STOCKS ---

* B shares of CCL Industries Inc fell 0.70 to 18.30 in mostly block trading. CCL reported second-quarter earnings late on Thursday of C$0.34 a share, compared to C$0.31 a share in the same period last year.
* Shares in Rio Alto Exploration Ltd dipped 0.05 to 11.75 in active trade after Rio Alto said it would issue 6.5 million common shares at C$11.75 each on a bought deal basis.
* SR Telecom Inc shares rose 0.75 to 9.25 in healthy trade after the Montreal-based company reported second-quarter earnings of C$0.089 versus year earlier C$0.028.
